title: Shadow autoscaler metric interference: validation plan and mitigations
creator: Priya Nair
description: Summary: During a capacity incident on 2026-02-16 we observed rapid oscillation in pod counts for the text-generation service. Symptoms included: repeated KEDA scaler activations that immediately scaled up then scaled down, combined with HPA readouts that suggested pods were underutilized. Root cause analysis shows two correlated issues. First, a "shadow" autoscaler we deployed for canary experiments emitted duplicate synthetic metrics into the metrics pipeline when its exporter restarted (metric name suffixing + tag mismatch). Second, the prometheus sidecar exporter applied a relabel rule that collapsed source tags, causing KEDA's scaler to see amplified rates (duplicates aggregated) while HPA percentile probes (based on kubelet / custom probe) temporarily reported stale utilization. The combined effect created false positives (KEDA over-trigger on spike) and false negatives (HPA failing to hold warm-pool sizing), causing warm pool depletion and cold-start amplification.
timeline: 2026-02-16 02:13 UTC: Alert - text-gen service 99th-percentile latency > 2s and 503s increased. Autoscale events spike observed.
2026-02-16 02:20 UTC: Ops throttled canary traffic and routed a percentage of requests to fallback model-variant. Latency partially recovered.
2026-02-16 03:05 UTC: Investigation: KEDA ScaledObject logs show duplicate trigger events from metrics endpoint; shadow-autoscaler pod restarts at 03:02 UTC correlated with duplicate metric series.
2026-02-16 04:10 UTC: Confirmed exporter relabel rule collapsed distinct job labels; KEDA's scaler query returned doubled counts for the same trigger window.
2026-02-16 05:00 UTC: Mitigation: Disable shadow autoscaler, roll back exporter relabel change, and increase HPA stabilization window to reduce flapping. Incident declared mitigated at 05:12 UTC.
2026-02-17 09:00 UTC: Deep dive: reproduced at scale in staging with synthetic restarts and traffic bursts; reproduced metric duplication pattern and HPA undershoot.
2026-02-18 15:30 UTC: Postmortem write-up started; this ticket created to track follow-ups and validation plan.
root_cause: Shadow autoscaler experiment injected synthetic metrics without strict metric namespacing; restart of the experiment caused duplicate series to appear briefly.
Prometheus relabel rules in the exporter collapsed labels (job, instance) in some paths, merging distinct series and amplifying trigger counts.
HPA percentile-based probe window (short window) combined with KV cache misses caused transient underreported utilization, preventing HPA from holding prewarmed capacity.
No automated test coverage for metric-stream isolation for experiments (shadow autoscalers) nor end-to-end KEDA/HPA integration tests for duplicate metric scenarios.
action_items: AI-1: Add strict metric namespace enforcement for all canary/shadow autoscalers (prefix metrics with shadow_<key>) - owner: Liam O'Connell - due: 2026-03-05
AI-2: Revert/replace exporter relabel rule and add unit tests for relabel mappings; create canary pipeline for exporter changes - owner: Satomi Harada - due: 2026-03-08
AI-3: Implement deduplication layer in the metrics ingestion pipeline that detects identical series reappearance within a short TTL and collapses duplicates - owner: Miguel Torres - due: 2026-03-20
AI-4: Increase default HPA stabilization window and add a config knob per service to bias towards holding prewarm capacity for latency-sensitive routes - owner: Priya Nair - due: 2026-03-12
AI-5: Add integration test in infra-ci that restarts metric producers under load and asserts KEDA/HPA stability (test harness + chaos job) - owner: Jordan Blake - due: 2026-03-15
AI-6: Run a one-week smoke campaign in staging with shadow-autoscaler namespace enforcement and dedup enabled; collect metrics for regression detection - owner: SRE Team - due: 2026-03-28

AI-7: Update runbook: include 'disable shadow autoscaler' and 'verify exporter relabel rules' as immediate mitigation steps; add dashboard panel for duplicate-series rate - owner: Leah Morgan - due: 2026-03-10
decisions: D1: Disallow non-namespaced metric names from experiments by policy; experiment tooling will automatically add a 'shadow/' prefix.
D2: Introduce a short-term metric dedup TTL (30s) in ingestion to blunt transient duplicate spikes while we implement smarter dedup logic.
D3: Default HPA stabilization window will be increased from 30s to 120s for services annotated 'latency-sensitive=true'.
tests_and_validation: Test-1: Staging chaos test that restarts a shadow-autoscaler 100x over 1 hour while emitting production-like traffic; verify KEDA trigger rate does not exceed baseline + 10%.
Test-2: Integration test that injects duplicated series (synthetic) into ingestion and asserts deduplication TTL collapses counts correctly.
Test-3: Canary rollout of relabel exporter change to 5% of pods with automated rollback on increase in duplicate-series dashboard metric.
